snippet.title: Ecto Mercenary Program Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805240/Ecto_Mercenary_Program/

Ecto Mercenary Program. or EMP for short. is a sci-fi looter shooter where you and your friends form a mercenary group to forge a path for yourselves. Rise from a destitute crew fighting raiders for scraps to a feared force on the station. Survival is not guaranteed.
